problem: Customer version 1.0.52 authenticated SSH successfully, then closed the transport when local password recovery record validation could not complete. The exact customer filesystem/validation cause remains unknown.
scope: Host-side login admission and automation guards only. Existing OpenWrt recovery commands, identity checks and restore verification are unchanged.
behavior: Only recovery record read/validation failures become a connected session with an explicit warning.
Skip ALL login-time mutating cleanup in this degraded state; retain original records unchanged.
Keep device information, dependency checks, terminal access and read-only management available.
Block wireless tasks, automatic management writes and dependency install/uninstall through existing shared task boundaries.
Bind the block to the authenticated device fingerprint; clear only after a successful recovery recheck.
Do not downgrade cancellation or a started-but-unverified recovery transaction.
Export only allowlisted error category/type and integer native codes, never record contents, paths or credentials.

verification.warnings: Some older management Qt fixtures emit callbacks with incomplete SimpleNamespace ssh objects; suites reported zero failures/errors. Those fixtures were not modified.

sources.purpose: Keep inaccessible/invalid record storage distinct from no pending records.
Classify local storage exceptions and retain bounded native error codes without raw messages.

delivery: Source modified; no package created. Previously delivered 1.0.52 ZIP is unchanged.
